newsitem.title: USA: Bally Total Fitness Corp Q3 full results.
newsitem.headline: Bally Total Fitness Corp Q3 full results.

text.p: NOTES: Co was unit of Bally Entertainment Corp until spinoff. Distribution of co common stock as dividend commenced Jan. 9, 1996. Historical net loss for three months ended September 30, 1995 of $6.5 million reflects federal income tax benefit of about $3 million from co's prior tax sharing agreement with Bally.

Pro forma net loss reflects adjustments for income tax benefit as if co had filed its own separate consolidated income tax returns for such period and distribution of 11.8 million shrs of co common stock to Bally shareholders as if distribution took place at beginning of period.

NOTES: Historical net loss for 9-mos ended September 30, 1995 of $12.5 million reflects federal income tax benefit of approximately $5.5 million arising from co's prior tax sharing agreement with Bally. Pro forma net loss reflects adjustments made to reflect income tax benefit as if co filed its own separate consolidated income tax returns for such period and the distribution of 11.8 million shrs of co common stock to Bally shareholders as if such distribution had taken place as of the beginning of the period.
